name: Gästehaus Bergland
beschreibung: The Gästehaus Bergland is situated in a quiet location in Tirol, surrounded by the typical Alpine landscape. The surroundings are characterized by extensive forests and the nearby mountain peaks. The inn offers a simple, traditional atmosphere with a Tirol-style parlor. Guests can expect regional cuisine as well as a terrace with valley view. In summer, the surroundings are ideal for hikes and mountain bike tours. In the winter months, the nearby ski areas and cross-country ski trails are easily accessible. The quiet location of the house allows relaxation in nature.
